meta.title: Molar Flow Converter — Convert Mole/second and More
meta.description: Free molar flow converter for 5+ units including Mole/second, Millimole/second, Kilomole/second. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: mol/s, mmol/s, kmol/h. Convert between 5 molar flow units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for molar flow in this tool is **mols**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most molar flow conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Mole/second | mol/s |
| Millimole/second | mmol/s |
| Kilomole/second | kmol/s |
| Mole/minute | mol/min |
| Mole/hour | mol/h |
content.use_cases:
- Recipe scaling and bartending where measures span metric and imperial.
- Fuel economy comparisons across regions.
- Lab dosing and reagent prep across mL, L, and US/UK units.
- Aquarium, pool, and tank capacity calculations.
- Shipping fluid product specs across markets.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this molar flow converter?
**A:** It uses 5 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Mole/second (mol/s), Millimole/second (mmol/s), Kilomole/second (kmol/s), Mole/minute (mol/min), Mole/hour (mol/h).
